ASM — Das Spiel: adventure development build (debug)

Adventure development build: the original intro now launches the complete compiled main source. Choose JOY for the full view (IO Light intentionally shows half). Click through the opening messages, then use ⌨ to type the requested letter of ASM. All 23 rooms are included. Some missing artwork was restored from older supplied disks. The full quest and minigames remain under development.

Controls

Use the mouse or touch to select commands and objects. Open ⌨ for text input; Enter and Backspace go directly to AMOS. Choose Keyboard: Typing to enter text; switch back to Keyboard: Joystick to play. Gamepad and touch controls work in both modes. Escape leaves fullscreen.
